messages:
Lina: Quick note  I'm prepping a tiny quickstart refresh to fix auth wording and add a one-file Docker example. Will open a WIP PR shortly.
Shane: Nice. Can you avoid mentioning REDWOOD_API_KEY? We've standardized on REDWOOD_KEY now.
Lina: Yep, will swap. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523 (WIP)  files: /get-started/quickstart.md, /examples/docker-quickstart.md.
DocBot: PR #523 opened by Lina  CI: pending  reviewers: @Asha, @Marco
Asha: Heads-up: the Docker example should demonstrate passing env var securely (--env-file) rather than embedding key in Dockerfile. Small code snippet OK.
Marco: Also include a tiny compose example for local testing. One service, expose 8080. Keep it minimal.
Lina: Proposed Docker snippet: ```dockerfile
FROM node:18
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","server.js"]
# run: docker run --env-file .env -p 8080:8080 demo:latest
```
Shane: Good. Add a note about ephemeral tokens for front-end demos and link to /security/ephemeral-tokens.
Asha: I'll review the English copy. Tiny nit: change "quickstart will" to "this quickstart" in first paragraph.
Lina: Updated. Also added a one-liner about choosing rwd-1-small for faster cold-starts.
DocBot: CI checks: markdown-lint failed  reason: heading-style, but snippet tests passed.
Lina: Fixed heading style. Re-pushed.
DocBot: CI passed for PR #523  mergeable: true
Marco: LGTM, approving.
Asha: Approved.
Lina: Merged PR #523  commit: d4e5f6a  docs build queued
Shane: Thanks! I'll schedule a quick grep sweep for REDWOOD_API_KEY across docs tomorrow.
Lina: Thanks team :shipit:
